ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The photo is an aerial overhead view of the Qilian Mountains; the ridges and valleys extend obliquely, and the contrast between light and dark on the mountain slopes is obvious; some bright white sunlit or snow-covered areas and darker shadow areas can be seen. On the right side of the figure there are direction-indicating arrows: Jia is above, Yi is to the right, Bing is below, and Ding is to the left. Then reason: The question stem gives the time as mid-August, and the plane took off from Xi'an at 18:30; when it passed through the Qilian Mountains, it was already close to evening, and the Sun was roughly on the western side. According to the distribution of bright slopes and shadows in the figure, it can be judged that the illumination comes from the west side, thereby restoring the approximate orientation relationship in the photo. The flight route from Xi'an to Urumqi has an actual overall direction from southeast to northwest. Projecting this actual heading onto the direction labels in the figure corresponds to the leftward direction Ding in the figure.

<image1>

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：照片为祁连山航空俯视图，山体明暗对比明显，右侧有甲、乙、丙、丁四个方向箭头，其中丁为图中向左。再结合题干时间，飞机18:30后途经祁连山，应为傍晚，太阳在西侧。根据图中山坡亮面和阴影，确定照片中西侧的大致位置，并据此还原图上的东、西、南、北关系。最后由文本给出的航程“西安飞往乌鲁木齐”判定飞机实际航向为由东南向西北，投影到照片方向标注中对应向左，因此选丁方向。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：照片是祁连山的航空俯视图，山岭和沟谷呈斜向延伸，山坡明暗对比明显，可见一些亮白的受光或积雪区域以及较暗的阴影区域。图右侧有方向示意箭头：甲在上方，乙在右方，丙在下方，丁在左方。再推理：题干给出时间为8月中旬，飞机18:30从西安起飞，途经祁连山时已接近傍晚，太阳大致位于西侧。根据图中山坡亮面与阴影的分布，可判断光照来自西侧，从而还原照片中的大致方位关系。航线从西安飞往乌鲁木齐，实际总体方向是由东南向西北。把这一实际航向投影到图中方向标注上，对应的是图中向左的丁方向。
